title: A Mosaic Carpet of Umayyad Date at Khirbat al Mafjar
author: R. W. Hamilton
location_note: Bath building 40 m north of the palace at Kh. al Mafjar; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: One page on the tree-and-lion mosaic of the apsidal room of the Umayyad baths (cleared 1944-8); general site plan. The baths are named, but no pool, channel or other eligible feature is described. No eligible feature.
